description: Trottoirs in der Stadt St.Gallen is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Stadt St.Gallen. Der Datensatz zeigt die Trottoirs der Stadt St.Gallen aus dem Grundbuchplan amtliche Vermessung. Coverage: Stadt St.Gallen. The portal files it under the publisher Stadt St.Gallen. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GPX, JSON, JSON-LD, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
